anybuild_findings.custom_output_dir: node_static uses the framework default output dir (get_static_dir, providers/node_static.rs ~454) and does not read astro.config outDir; a repo-root Staticfile `root:` overrides it (load_static_parts ~260). node_static Strong=60 > Staticfile=50 (providers/mod.rs ~420-450), so the framework build still runs. Minimal fix for non-default output: one-line Staticfile `root: <dir>`.

anybuild_replay_method: tools/anybuild_flat_replay.py: anybuild 0.33.0 `plan` on the patched tree, then its planned install/build commands run in a non-nested temp dir (copy package.json+lockfile -> install -> copy sources -> build), with the package-manager version Anybuild pins (declared packageManager, else pnpm 10 / npm 11 / bun 1, Node 24) and the ENV node.bzl sets (pnpm: CI, dangerously_allow_all_builds, strict_dep_builds=false, minimum_release_age=0; npm: CI, NPM_CONFIG_FUND=false). Separate from the repo's normal build and NOT a run of Wasmer's hosted builder. The anybuild local builder itself nests its temp dir inside the project, which breaks pnpm workspaces and tsconfig lookup; those local-builder failures are recorded in logs/*.anybuild-build.log as harness artifacts.
